newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO CUTS MORTGAGE RATES BY 0.3 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO CUTS MORTGAGE RATES BY 0.3 PERCENT.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank said on Thursday it will cut its mortgage lending rates by 0.3 percent from October 4.
The rate cut would apply to all ABN AMRO fixed and variable rate mortgages except for the so-called "green mortgage", which will be cut by 0.2 percent, ABN AMRO said in a statement.
"ABN AMRO is the first major party in the market to reduce its tariffs," the bank said.
The new reduced rate on a one-year fixed rate mortgage covered by the government's national mortgage guarantee scheme now stood at 3.9 percent, the bank said.
